tool_args.rationale: The five initial short-horizon rows could not identify slow adaptation at H=22.3. The acquired H=8, 15.5, and 23.8 observations show the predicted positive-to-negative reversal and, together with sink-gradient variation, support fitting the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon mechanism.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired slow-horizon probe adds three horizon-spanning observations, including negative outcomes; the 8 total rows now provide direct information on reversal and suffice to fit the five-parameter law.

considered_alternatives.option: open alternative dual-horizon model without sink coupling
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The measured sink-gradient variation and recalled verified source note support a coupled attenuation term; the added long-horizon rows discriminate adaptation reversal from a short-window-only fit.
The observed short-positive and long-negative trend is directly represented by dual-horizon adaptation, whereas no periodic/sign-oscillation evidence supports a harmonic cycle.
